name: Reissue a preempted read at the identical cursor; three retries per window leave all four scan slots available, including multiline data and exit-75 tail
Persist successful cursor progress before retry exhaustion; four preemptions tolerate one pass and the next failed pass writes a durable UNVERIFIED alarm
When the lane clears, the next cron pass resumes at the preserved cursor, reaches the tail and clears the read incident without modifying the reply log
